fields.label: Bucket Name
fields.help: Cloud Storage bucket name.

fields.label: Compression Mode
fields.help: Compress text responses using Brotli or gzip compression, based on the client's Accept-Encoding header.

fields.label: Custom Response Headers
fields.help: Headers that the HTTP/S load balancer should add to proxied responses.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional textual description of the resource; provided by the client when the resource is created.

fields.label: Edge Security Policy
fields.help: The security policy associated with this backend bucket.

fields.label: Enable CDN
fields.help: If true, enable Cloud CDN for this BackendBucket.

fields.label: Load Balancing Scheme
fields.help: The value can only be INTERNAL_MANAGED for cross-region internal layer 7 load balancer.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of the resource.

fields.label: CDN Policy
Cache Mode
fields.help: Specifies the cache setting for all responses from this backend.

fields.label: Client Ttl
fields.help: Specifies the maximum allowed TTL for cached content served by this origin.

fields.label: Default Ttl
fields.help: Specifies the default TTL for cached content served by this origin for responses that do not have an existing valid TTL (max-age or s-max-age).

fields.label: Max Ttl
fields.help: Specifies the maximum allowed TTL for cached content served by this origin.

fields.label: Negative Caching
fields.help: Negative caching allows per-status code TTLs to be set, in order to apply fine-grained caching for common errors or redirects.

fields.label: Request Coalescing
fields.help: If true then Cloud CDN will combine multiple concurrent cache fill requests into a small number of requests to the origin.

fields.label: Serve While Stale
fields.help: Serve existing content from the cache (if available) when revalidating content with the origin, or when an error is encountered when refreshing the cache.

fields.label: Signed URL Cache Max Age Sec
fields.help: Maximum number of seconds the response to a signed URL request will be considered fresh.

Header Name

fields.label: Cache Key Policy
Include Http Headers
fields.help: Allows HTTP request headers (by name) to be used in the cache key.

fields.label: Query String Whitelist
fields.help: Names of query string parameters to include in cache keys.
The CacheKeyPolicy for this CdnPolicy.

fields.label: Negative Caching Policy
Code
fields.help: The HTTP status code to define a TTL against.

fields.help: The TTL (in seconds) for which to cache responses with the corresponding status code.
